scenes.title: Device management, made simple.
scenes.subtitle: One place to manage your connected devices.
scenes.text: With SuiFleet, managing your devices is simple. Bring your devices together, organize them into groups, and keep their software up to date from one console.

scenes.title: You stay in control.
scenes.subtitle: A wallet is your secure approval app.
scenes.text: You choose what changes, and which devices receive it. Your wallet acts as a secure approval app. It confirms your permission, without sharing your private key.

scenes.title: Prepare once. Deliver across your fleet.
scenes.subtitle: Approvals and software files have different jobs.
scenes.text: Sui saves your approval on a shared network. Walrus stores your software files for the period you choose. Private releases are encrypted, with access limited to authorized devices.

scenes.title: Devices check for their updates.
scenes.subtitle: Connections start from your devices.
scenes.text: The SuiFleet client on each device checks for approved updates on its configured schedule. Connections start from the device, so you do not need to open an incoming connection.

scenes.title: The right release, checked before use.
scenes.subtitle: Download and verify the approved software.
scenes.text: When an update is available, the device downloads it from Walrus and verifies that it matches the approved release. A device that reconnects can catch up while the update remains available.

scenes.title: Works with your installation process.
scenes.subtitle: Your platform controls installation and reboot.
scenes.text: SuiFleet then runs your configured installer. Your platform handles installation, any reboot, and recovery. This lets you use the update process that suits your devices.

scenes.title: Know how the rollout is progressing.
scenes.subtitle: Installation results and health are separate.
scenes.text: See which installations succeeded and which failed. Device health is reported separately. If an update fails, review the available diagnostics before trying again.

scenes.title: Start small. Expand with confidence.
scenes.subtitle: Choose a group. Validate. Roll out in stages.
scenes.text: Start with a small group, check the results, and expand your rollout in stages. You stay in control of the release, while SuiFleet coordinates delivery across your fleet.
